name: codeology-platform
description: Codeology curriculum, product shell and assessment platform

scripts.check:content: python scripts/audit_lessons.py && python scripts/audit_certifications.py && python scripts/backfill_certification_references.py --check && python scripts/debias_certification_questions.py --check && python scripts/build_readme_i18n.py --check && python scripts/run_translation_workflow_tests.py
scripts.check:precommit: npm run check:skills && python scripts/audit_lessons.py && python scripts/audit_certifications.py
scripts.test: npm run check:content && npm run check:skills && npm run test:certifications
scripts.ci:strict: npm run ci && npm run check:legacy-quiz-order
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run ci && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run ci && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy --prod
